_readme: Car specs (app/data/mot_specs.py, eea_specs.py, specs_store.py). Shown as information only: the specs never enter the net calculation. The snapshot (cache/specs-snapshot.json) is made by: python -m scripts.build_specs_snapshot

mot.source: משרד התחבורה, data.gov.il: תוצרים ודגמים של כלי רכב WLTP (מתעדכן כל יום)

eea.source: EEA, CO2 emissions from new passenger cars (discodata). Updated once a year; provisional data (P) is replaced by final (F) about a year later
eea._tables: Newest first; each car gets the first table with data. Checked 2026-10-19: co2cars holds 2010-2022 (2022 provisional only); 2023 and 2024 have final tables (co2cars_2023Fv28, co2cars_2024Fv30, named in the EEA catalogue); 2025 provisional only. The version suffix changes with each release.
eea._reliability: Each EEA row is one registration, and some are junk (15 Wh/km is a kWh/100km unit error; 420-520 in the consumption column are range values). A measure is P5-P95 weighted by registrations. If P95 > maxSpreadRatio x P5 it is unreliable and not shown; each measure takes the newest year where it is reliable.
eea._sanity: Used only by a test (shown consumption of an electric car is in this range). Never used to filter.

columns._checked: 2026-10-19 against the API: 'Z (Wh/km)' = electric energy consumption, 'Zr' = electric range (km). There is no 'Electric range (km)' column (error 10003).

fuel.source: US EPA, 'Greenhouse Gas Emissions from a Typical Passenger Vehicle' (https://www.epa.gov/greenvehicles/greenhouse-gas-emissions-typical-passenger-vehicle): 8,887 g CO2 per gallon of gasoline = 2,348 g per litre; 10,180 g per gallon of diesel = 2,689 g per litre. An approximation: the exact WLTP carbon balance (Regulation (EU) 2017/1151, Annex XXI, Sub-Annex 7) also counts HC and CO, and the test fuel differs. To verify.
fuel.note: By delek_nm in the Ministry of Transport (the official source, not the catalog): petrol and hybrid (בנזין), diesel (דיזל). Plug-in: not computed (WLTP CO2 depends on charging). Electric: not applicable.

indices._note: The data.gov.il field descriptions are empty, so the directions come from the sources below (decided 2026-10-19). Electric cars have no kvutzat_zihum / madad_yarok in the source.

nikud_betihut.sourceNote: Ministry of Transport safety equipment rating: score 0-8, and 10.5 points = 8

ramat_eivzur_betihuty.sourceNote: Ministry of Transport safety equipment level 0-8

madad_yarok.sourceNote: The raw score the pollution group (kvutzat_zihum) is derived from

knownMissing._note: Catalog cars the source has no rows for (checked 2026-10-19). A test checks every car is found or listed here.
